title: Echo Duel
description: Instrument-stream run against a local creator preview of the workspace copy, per the games/smoke.json pattern: `npx @dcl/sdk-commands start --no-browser --port 8022` in the scene dir, `decentra-bevy --server http://127.0.0.1:8022 --mcp --mcp-port 8132`. The realm below is that url because it is what this explorer reports as its realm (measured 2026-08-22, current bevy build; the LocalPreview name smoke.json documents is what an older build reported) - the wrong-world gate then refuses any client that is not in this exact preview. The port is pinned per scene by scripts/foundry-bench-scenes.sh. The scene self-plays: src/driver.ts plays both hot-seat seats through the same state API the HUD buttons use (the MCP surface has no UI clicks, so without it only the boot-time config line would ever fire). Each seat recalls up to a fixed memory span and goes all-in once the shared sequence outgrows it, so wagers, haptic/shake feedback cues, zero-sum transfers, match ends and the session counter all land on a bounded clock; a match ends in roughly 20 s and the 75 s wait covers several.

steps.label: several driver matches run to completion; the log ring is drained throughout

checks.why: a scene that throws on load looks fine in a screenshot and is broken
an async failure the scene swallowed still leaves state half-applied
the pinned rules and doc §9 targets are emitted at every match start
doc §9 'turn_wager_amount', extension-indexed for the avg-wager-by-extension read
doc §5: a correct recall tap fires the haptic-pulse cue
doc §5: a failed recall fires the screen-shake cue
doc §2 Transfer row: the wager moves loser to rival, zero-sum, never points from nowhere
the shared sequence grows one tile per successful turn
doc §9 'match_end_extension_count' - the contestability instrument, one line per match end
doc §9 'session_match_count' - the retention instrument counts finished matches
